title: AI Agent Wabi Reaches $1.25B Valuation Following Funding
excerpt: Wabi, an AI tool that creates mini apps and now functions as a personal agent, has secured $55 million in new funding.
body_html:
Wabi, an artificial intelligence application that creates mini apps, has announced a new funding round that brings its valuation to $1.25 billion. The company, which now positions itself as a personal agent, secured $55 million in the latest financing.

The announcement was made on Thursday by the company. Further details regarding the participants in the funding round or specific plans for the newly raised capital were not disclosed in the report.
